# Advanced Examples

高级组件通常需要受控数据、回调和性能边界，先看 props 再写示例。

每个组件一节，供 MCP `tigercat_component` 按 `## {Component}` 抽取。绑定差异见 `shared/patterns/common.md`。

## VirtualList

Runnable modules: `examples/example/vue3/src/examples/virtual-list/` and `examples/example/react/src/examples/virtual-list/`.

Vue: `<VirtualList :item-count="count" :item-height="40"><template #default="{ index }">{{ index }}</template></VirtualList>`

React: `<VirtualList itemCount={count} itemHeight={40} renderItem={({ index }) => <div>{index}</div>} />`

Imports: use PascalCase subpaths such as `@expcat/tigercat-vue/Button` and `@expcat/tigercat-react/Button`. Hooks and `notification` use the same subpath rule. Shared types and helpers come from `@expcat/tigercat-core`.
